query: I am planning a 2-day trip from Zhuhai to Guangzhou, departing on April 30, 2026 (Thursday) and returning on May 1, 2026 (Friday). There will be two of us, so one room is enough. For popular museums or major attractions, account for advance reservations, and make the intercity train numbers explicit.
